first.hello: Ah, there you are! I have been waiting for someone curious. Would you like a small gift?
first.yes: Take these two Meat and some bits. A good Tamer is always well fed.
first.no: Hm, maybe next time. The offer stands.
first.again: I have nothing more to give, but your company is a gift in itself.
first.persistent: You keep coming back. That is the spirit of a true Tamer!
